explanation: The 1688 article opens on the 1686 expedition and makes it the reason there was a battle at all: "In the Hudson Bay expedition (1686) the French had, in time of peace, marched overland from Quebec and captured all three English posts on James Bay. The French had left a garrison at Fort Albany and needed to send a ship to resupply it and take out the furs." The fight of 1688 is over a fort the earlier expedition had taken, which is what a precondition is. The sentences are not footnoted to any work Wikipedia names, so the confidence stays probable.
